item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-06-28
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 过去 24 小时 Nervos Talk 上关于 USDI 停服的讨论仍在发酵，社区成员就稳定币替代方案展开激烈辩论，同时有开发者分享了 CKB 开发工具包的新进展。[S02, S03, S04, S05, S01] ## 重点话题 **USDI 停服引发稳定币路线之争**：matt_ckb 继续追问提问者对项目产出的矛盾态度，试图厘清社区成员的期望值。[S02] 用户 Thinker 表达了对生态项目"存活即关停"循环的深层担忧，认为这冲击了长期建设信心。[S04] ArthurZhang 则明确表态，原生 USDC/USDT 才是解决合规与法币通道的正途，同时认可 LUSD 在去桥接风险上的优势，但指出其无法满足大规模商业采用。[S05] **旧桥资产被重新提起**：phroi 翻出历史记录，提醒社区 Force Bridge 多年前就已桥接过 USDT 和 USDC，并提供了链上合约地址供参考。[S03] **CKB 开发模板工具包推进中**：CrptoHead 更新了 CKB DevLaunch Kit 的规划，确认将基于现有 CKB 范例构建模板，首批涵盖最小化 xUDT、Spore/Dob NFT 示例及简单支付/托管合约。[S01] **论坛分类多语言支持待扩展**：matt_ckb 回应反馈，解释当前语言选择基于既有分区，但暗示未来可能增加更多语种支持。[S06] ## 值得继续跟进 USDI 关停后，官方或核心团队是否会推动原生稳定币接入 CKB，还是继续依赖桥接方案，这关系到生态 DeFi 基础设施的可靠性。[S04, S05]...

item.title: CKB DevLaunch Kit (1 posts)
item.description: Thanks! That’s a good point. I plan to base the templates on existing CKB examples and recommended tooling rather than creating new patterns. The initial examples would include a minimal xUDT token, an NFT example (Spore/Dob), and a simple payment/escrow contract. My focus is on packaging these into clean, well-documented starter templates with automated setup, deployment scripts, and explanations of the underlying Cell Model and transaction flow. I’m also happy to prioritize whichever examples the community feels would provide the most value for new developers.

item.title: USDI on CKB will be discontinued. Any alternative for stablecoin? (4 posts)
item.description: hi CDEX, didn’t see anyone else commenting to wanted to address your question. I wanted to ask if you could share how you reconcile your surprise that USDI is shutting down with “there has been no tangible outcome so far.” It would help me to understand how you view things if you could take a moment to explain this. From my understanding USDI did take a considerable amount of effort to set up, and after 2 years the IPN team found it was not a successful business endeavor for them. Stablecoins seem like a power law distribution, there is USDC, USDT, and then there is everything else. USDI is an example of the challenges faced by other stablecoins.
